statusCopy: UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

audience.programmeDescription: UvA’s Arabic Studies major builds spoken and written Arabic alongside the study of Middle Eastern history, society and literature. Students spend a semester in Cairo and use Arabic sources in their thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR courses include Arabic myths in comparative literature and Islamic courts in the study of Mediterranean art. They offer points of connection with the UvA degree. UCR lacks the Arabic language sequence and the sustained regional study needed for a full comparison.
